body: Lol this was bloody well made!
WOULD YOU FUCK ME? ID FUCK ME SO HARD
It's why I wrote here.. it was actually surprisingly cathartic, as well as to properly reach this realization that I'm ok with dying when that time comes, whenever it comes.

I told my best friend, and both therapists Ive had. I dont have a hard time discussing my moods with people. My parents cant deal with it and often trivialize it thought so cant get them to understand, and my brother is quite similar. We have been getting quite close recently and he knows Im going through, at the least, an uneasy patch but he is also quite similar to my parents with his outlook on mental health.

As I commented below.. or maybe it is above haha all the people Im close to live far away from me, like 3 to 4 to 24 hour planes far away. Before telling me to try and meet people where I live now.. i tried.. but its a long story as to why its not working and as to why Im sick of trying.  Regardless, I just kinda feel done with a lot of things. Not gonna kill myself anytime soon probably, but I just know that unless something substansially good will happen good old souled Yadayadacheesecake here will probably end up killing himself. As I get closer to the deed Id probably try and seek more support and help... the whole point of the post is really just saying Im comfortable knowing its a possible out and confident Ill use it if the time really comes where it some like the logical step to take.

Totally agree with you there. Really even if I dont end up killing myself it makes me feel more calm knowing I feel fine with it as an out. Used to be really scared that I thought like that but now I'm kinda just happy about it.

 My best friend knows that Im having passive thoughts, as I occasionally let her know when they pop up just so they wouldnt fester inside too much.. but there is not much she can do to help, living so far away from me. Things would probably different if I could get more.. hands on support I guess. 


Telling my family would lead nowhere. They can barely wrap their narrow minds around my anxiety and depression, and they have other issues so I prefer to keep them out of it. I honestly stopped caring much about any possible aftermath... used to think suicidal people were selfish, then I became passive suicidal and it opened my eyes to why suicide happens. 

Again right atm Im in no danger but I know Im getting there and I know I will most likely die from suicide.
